presets.title: Purifiers with a smoke CADR of 260+ cfm (enough for about 400 sq ft)

scope.basis: Purifiers on the ENERGY STAR list or with a maker page. Ranking per filter dollar is not offered: filter prices are preview-only by policy (dated store prices).

presets.title: Full-size counter-depth refrigerators up to 36 in wide with 20+ cu ft, ENERGY STAR, 600 kWh/yr or less

scope.basis: Full-size (not compact) refrigerators their ENERGY STAR filing declares counter-depth, by concrete model number. ENERGY STAR certified patterns (one filing covering several finishes or hinges, e.g. BRB106003**) are left out: their width does not transfer to a specific SKU (A1 ruling). Capacity is the DOE total volume (fresh + freezer), never the larger adjusted volume or a model-number size class. Counter-depth is the maker's own ENERGY STAR declaration; ENERGY STAR publishes no depth, so check the depth on the maker's sheet.

presets.title: Zigbee motion sensors that also report light level (lux), working locally with Zigbee2MQTT

scope.basis: Zigbee devices in the Zigbee2MQTT device database (a community integration database, not the maker), so every row works locally with an open Zigbee coordinator, no vendor hub or cloud. Lux means the sensor reports a light level over Zigbee; a day/night flag (IKEA TRADFRI) does not count. No means the definition lists everything the device exposes and lux is not in it. Device type is a rule over what the device exposes (most specific first), or its description when the exposes do not decide it.
